title: The Bannai–Munemasa–Venkov lattice method for strongly regular graphs: a uniform discriminant-form condition and new nonexistence results
summary: Bannai, Munemasa and Venkov, and later Nebe and Venkov, excluded tight spherical designs — among them strongly regular graphs of a special kind — by studying the lattice spanned by the design: they bound its discriminant group, pass to an even (over)lattice, and compare Gauss sums by the Milgram–Braun formula. We extend this method to arbitrary strongly regular graphs with integral eigenvalues.
